Added F7; the audit now has seven confirmed, reproducible findings in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/report.md).

| Severity | Finding |
|---|---|
| High | Snapshot install persists the log purge before the state-machine install completes; a crash leaves an unrecoverable state and restart panics. |
| Medium | Documented-valid `PartialSuccess(None)` panics the leader in debug builds. |
| Low/Medium | `purge_batch_size = 0` underflows at `calc_purge_upto()`'s `purge_end - 1`. |
| Medium | `snapshot_max_chunk_size = 0` makes `Chunked::send_snapshot()` send zero-byte chunks forever. |
| Low/Medium | Blocking `add_learner()` returns `Ok` after a leadership change while the learner is still not caught up. |
| Low/Medium | `heartbeat_interval = 0` is accepted and leaves the tick loop unthrottled. |
| Low/Medium | `install_snapshot_timeout = 0` is accepted and every snapshot RPC times out immediately. |

The new F7 evidence: `Config::build` accepts `--install-snapshot-timeout=0`, and the chunked transport with a zero `RPCOption` hard TTL fails the install RPC immediately:

```
zero install-snapshot timeout result is_err=true, calls=1
```

Reproduction: `cargo test -p openraft --lib --features generic-snapshot-data audit_install_snapshot_timeout_zero -- --nocapture`; the test is in `network/snapshot_transport.rs` and included in the patch. The report recommends rejecting a zero install timeout or clamping it to a minimum.

Verification after F7: 194 default-library tests and 205 `generic-snapshot-data` tests pass; the full `tests` package still passes with all three audit integration tests. Sources, logs, and patches are under [audit](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/audit). The remaining source-based follow-up is the `QuitLeader` replication-map retention note in the unresolved section; the zero-valued config options have now all been investigated.
